privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: My Perfect Party respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is handled when you use our application.
privacy.localDataBody: My Perfect Party does not require an account. Your event data — including guests, seating plans, expenses, tasks, and notes — is stored locally on your device. We do not operate servers that collect or store your personal planning data, and the developer does not have access to your content.
privacy.adsBody: The app displays ads through Google AdMob. AdMob may collect device information, advertising identifiers, IP address, and data about your interactions with ads to serve and measure advertising. This data is processed by Google in accordance with Google's policies.
privacy.adsLink: Learn more about how Google uses data from apps that use its services
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your personal data. Third-party services such as Google AdMob have their own privacy policies and may process data as described in their terms.
privacy.childrenBody: My Perfect Party is not intended to collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information through the app, please contact us.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your use of the My Perfect Party application.
terms.acceptanceBody: By downloading, installing, or using My Perfect Party, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.serviceBody: My Perfect Party is a local-first party planning app. It helps you manage events, guest lists, seating arrangements, expenses, tasks, and related planning details. Core features work offline and data is stored on your device.
terms.accountBody: The app does not require you to create an account or sign in. You are responsible for the information you enter and for keeping your device secure.
terms.userContentBody: You are solely responsible for the accuracy and legality of the guest names, contact details, notes, and other content you add to the app. Do not enter information you are not permitted to store or share.
terms.backupBody: You may optionally send a backup of your data to your email address. You are responsible for safeguarding backup files and for restoring data when needed. We are not responsible for lost, corrupted, or inaccessible backups.
terms.adsBody: The free version of the app may show ads through Google AdMob. Ads may appear when using certain features. Google may collect and process data related to ad delivery as described in its policies.
terms.adsLink: Learn more about how Google uses data from apps that use its services
terms.notificationsBody: If you enable reminders, the app schedules local notifications on your device for tasks and upcoming events. Notification delivery depends on your device settings and permissions.
terms.availabilityTitle: Changes to the service and terms
terms.availabilityBody: We may update the app, these Terms, or discontinue features at any time. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms. We may also update the Privacy Policy from time to time.
terms.liabilityBody: My Perfect Party is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the app, including data loss, planning errors, missed reminders, or issues related to ads or third-party services.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these Terms, contact us at {{email}}.

ads.title: Ads in the app
ads.intro: The free version of My Perfect Party is supported by ads. This page explains where ads appear and when you may be asked to watch a short rewarded ad.
ads.rewardedIntro: Some actions ask you to watch a short ad before continuing. If you close the ad early, the action may not complete.
ads.themeBody: App and event themes can be changed freely. Rewarded ads are not required for themes.
ads.deleteEventBody: When you are online, deleting an event requires watching a short ad.
ads.guestsBody: The first 30 people in total are free. After that, every additional block of 30 people requires watching a short ad before you can add more.
ads.tablesBody: The first 9 tables are free. After that, every additional block of 10 tables requires watching a short ad before you can add more.
ads.invitationBody: Sharing or downloading an invitation image may require watching a short ad when you are online.
ads.nativeIntro: Native ads may appear in scrollable content and are clearly labeled as ads.
ads.nativeListsBody: On the Overview, Guests, Tasks, Expenses, and Seating tabs, a native ad may appear at the bottom of the list.
ads.nativeFormsBody: When adding or editing a guest, table, expense, or task, or when creating tables in bulk, a native ad may appear in the form.
ads.bannerBody: A banner ad may appear at the bottom of guest, expense, task, table, and bulk table forms.
ads.offlineBody: Rewarded ads require an internet connection. If you are offline, the action may not be available. In Expo Go, test ad previews are shown instead of real ads.

usage.title: How to use the app
usage.intro: Plan your celebration step by step. Tap a topic below to learn what each screen does.
usage.homeBody: All your events are here. Gear opens Settings. + creates an event. Tap a card to open it, or the pencil to edit name, date, location, and theme.
usage.eventsBody: Set name, date & time, location, and theme. You can add guest categories and sides. Save keeps each event’s guests, tables, expenses, and tasks separate.
usage.eventHeaderBody: Pencil — edit event. Download — export PDF. Trash — delete event (confirm; online may show a short ad). On Seating, View hall opens the floor plan.
usage.tabsBody: Overview — summary. Guests — list & attendance. Seating — tables. Expenses — budget. Tasks — to-dos before the day.
usage.overviewBody: Countdown, attendance chart, and quick stats. Create invitation opens the editor. Quick actions: Add guest, Manage seating, Add expense.
usage.guestsBody: Search, filter, and sort guests. Tap a card to edit. Tap the status badge to cycle attendance. Trash deletes; + adds a guest.
usage.guestFormBody: Name, party size, phone, category, side, notes, attendance, and table. Save to store. Online, a short ad may appear every 30 people.
usage.seatingBody: See occupied vs free seats. Tap Total / Full / Available to filter tables. Unassigned guests show as chips — tap one to assign a table.
usage.tablesBody: + adds one table or bulk-creates many. Eye — preview & assign guests. Pencil — edit. Trash — delete. Online, every 10 tables may show a short ad.
usage.hallBody: View hall: zoom with +/−, drag to pan, drag tables to move them. In preview: Assign guest, or tap a guest to remove them from the table. Use arrows to reorder seats.
usage.expensesBody: Totals and charts at the top. Tap an expense to edit; trash deletes. + adds name, amount, category, and who pays.
usage.obligationsBody: Your checklist before the celebration. Add templates for your theme, or +. Edit title, date & time, status, contact, and notes.
usage.invitationsBody: From Overview → Create invitation. Pick template, fonts, and text. Share or Download to gallery (mobile). Online may show a short ad.
usage.settingsBody: Language, theme, notifications, backup email, Play Store rating, privacy, terms, ads info, and this guide.
usage.backupBody: Data stays on your device. Send backup emails a JSON file. Import restores from a saved file — keep your backup safe.
